rules.description: tailwind.config.ts must use theme.extend — never replace the entire theme object
Colors must be expressed as CSS custom properties (--color-primary: ...) for runtime theming support
tailwind.config must reference var(--...) CSS vars, not hardcoded hex values
Semantic tokens (primary, secondary, destructive, muted, accent) must be defined as a layer above the raw palette
All declared contrast pairs must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text)
All token keys must be kebab-case — no camelCase, PascalCase, or underscores
If darkMode is enabled, every semantic color token must have a dark counterpart
Token keys must be unique across all categories (colors, spacing, typography, radius)
